sloka: ततो रामो महातेजा आर्तम् दृष्ट्वा हरीश्वरम् ।स शरम् वीक्षते वीरो वालिनो वध कांक्षया ॥४-१६-३२॥
transliteration: tato rāmo mahātejā ārtam dṛṣṭvā harīśvaram ।sa śaram vīkṣate vīro vālino vadha kāṁkṣayā ॥4-16-32॥

translations.english: Finding the king of the monkeys in distress, the heroic, brilliant Rama looked for an arrow in order to kill Vali.
